APPROVE

The extracted `CompareSegment` keeps the int/int, string/string and mixed-case (±1) logic exactly as it was, so behaviour is unchanged. It is a plain private static helper that should build cleanly, and it takes the if/else-if chain out of `Compare`, which should bring it under 15. I did not build or run the analyzer, so the complexity figure and the build are judged from reading the diff only.
